description: A custom TextureView class (AutoFitTextureView) that maintains a specified aspect ratio for camera preview purposes.

classes.name: AutoFitTextureView
classes.description: A TextureView that can be adjusted to a specified aspect ratio with logic to measure and set its dimensions accordingly.

methods.name: setAspectRatio
methods.description: Sets the aspect ratio for the view, updating measured dimensions accordingly.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overrides default measurement to adjust view size based on the specified aspect ratio.
